sourceAuthority: User explicitly authorised reasonable internal estimates without third-party confirmation on2026-11-28.
escalationNote: Constant2026budget prices; no forecast or price guarantee. Uncertainty and FX are covered only by the stated scenario/reserve.

lines.label: Q190 core equipment
lines.basis: Same four sensors, RS485 and provisional four glands; native listings converted at historical budget rate.

lines.label: Reference power, electronics enclosure and microSD
lines.basis: Six listed components; not a complete tested solar installation.

lines.label: One optional shared pH kit, included in this scenario
lines.basis: One physical shared kit at a time; not three initial spares.

lines.label: Initial shared buffer and KCl stock
lines.basis: Two 500mL buffer bottles and one 18mL KCl bottle. Replenishment below excludes these starter bottles.

lines.label: Panel/probe brackets and protective cage
lines.basis: Per-site fabricated support allowance; no supplier quote or structural acceptance.

lines.label: Ventilated weather protection for AGM battery
lines.basis: Separate from the listed electronics enclosure; mounting/fit/ventilation still engineering assumptions.

lines.label: Outdoor wire, conduit and connectors
lines.basis: Allow 10m/site at 30000 VND/m plus 200000 fittings in base; lengths are assumptions, not surveyed measurements.

lines.label: DC fuses, isolation and terminals
lines.basis: Per-site parts allowance, not a validated protection design.

lines.label: Earthing and surge-protection materials
lines.basis: Cost allowance; soil/lightning/site requirements may alter scope.

lines.label: Additional analog/interface and small integration parts
lines.basis: Excludes the already priced RS485 converter; not an assertion that a particular ADC is required.

lines.label: Bench integration, firmware and offline-buffer work
lines.basis: Six 8-hour person-days; not completed engineering work or field validation.

lines.label: Site assembly and initial commissioning labour
lines.basis: Two person-days/site, including initial calibration labour; materials and reference services separately itemised.

lines.label: Planning, survey and deployment preparation labour
lines.basis: Two person-days/project; no survey results are claimed.

lines.label: Operator training and handover labour
lines.basis: Two person-days/project; recipients remain proposed.

lines.label: Reference instruments / independent acceptance service
lines.basis: Allowance/site for hire or verification; not arranged free equipment or a certified laboratory quotation.

lines.label: International shipment allowance
lines.basis: Two phased supply orders; destination, battery restrictions and carton weights unconfirmed.

lines.label: Domestic equipment delivery allowance
lines.basis: Cargo delivery/site; the public 110000 Hanoi minimum is a benchmark, not a complete quoted route. Not crew transport.

lines.label: Additional commissioning mobilisation
lines.basis: Two extra mobilisation routes outside the 36 routine rounds; no repeated charge for the same journey.

lines.label: Unspecified supply tax/import/payment allowance
lines.basis: 5/10/20% analyst reserve on 44434844 VND of unclear-tax goods and assumed delivery. Not statutory VAT or duty; no second VAT on explicitly VAT-included goods.

lines.label: Monthly on-site calibration/cleaning/testing crew
lines.basis: 36 grouped route-days x 2 technicians, 8h each. Includes all 96 monthly pH tasks, monthly DO cleaning, two-monthly DO/turbidity calibration and 16 six-month checks; no second calibration labour fee.

lines.label: Routine field-route transport
lines.basis: 12 routes/year across active stations; 6 testing rounds are included, not 6 extra trips. 300000/route is analyst allowance, not cargo fare.

lines.label: Daily remote review and alert triage
lines.basis: 15 minutes/day, 365/366/365 civil days; 600000/8=75000 per hour in base. No 24/7 staffed response/SLA is implied.

lines.label: Software upkeep, backups and release checks
lines.basis: Four person-hours/shared system-month, separate from daily triage and on-site work.

lines.label: Connect8 30-day service cycles
lines.basis: Dated 2027-01-01 / 2027-07-01 illustration, 37+31+31 prepaid cycles; eligibility unverified.

lines.label: SIM setup and activation allowance
lines.basis: Analyst allowance, not a published activation fee.

lines.label: Shared web and Postgres compute
lines.basis: 7+6 USD/shared month; no multiplication by three stations.

lines.label: Assumed 20GB Postgres storage
lines.basis: 20GB x USD0.30/GB-month. Capacity is assumed; 30-day raw-data retention plus aggregates, no full raw three-year archive guarantee.

lines.label: Cloud traffic, exports and service-fee allowance
lines.basis: USD6/shared month internal reserve beyond compute/storage; not a Render bundle, workspace contract or paid MQTT quote.

lines.label: Quarterly fresh shared pH buffer pairs after starter
lines.basis: 12 quarterly pairs total less one initial pair; 4.01/7.01 labelled values need procedure/temperature validation. Manufacturer expiry overrides the assumed quarterly refresh.

lines.label: Quarterly KCl stock after starter
lines.basis: Two 18mL bottles/quarter x12 quarters less one starter bottle. Budget quantity, not measured consumption.

lines.label: Rinse water, cleaning supplies and waste containers
lines.basis: One shared batch/route; keep contaminated standards separate from clean stocks.

lines.label: Turbidity calibration standard allowance
lines.basis: Two-monthly early calibration on monthly visits: 18+15+15 tasks, not 48 trips. This replaces the independent strict-90-day example only within this planning scenario.

lines.label: DO calibration reference/standard allowance
lines.basis: Two-monthly early calibration includes the manufacturer three-month recommendation; method/material suitability unverified. Labour is in monthly crew.

lines.label: Field consumables and PPE
lines.basis: Small per-route consumables allowance; no hazardous-space entry or boat work included.

lines.label: Unscheduled response labour and travel pool
lines.basis: Two extra events/year; per event two technician-days plus one extra trip. Parts below are separate reserves. No restoration-time guarantee.

lines.label: Independent verification / laboratory screening pool
lines.basis: Two events/year; analyst allowance, not an accredited enforcement sample quotation.

lines.label: Messaging allowance
lines.basis: Internal monthly allowance; no assumed free public SMS from the SIM plan.

lines.label: DO cap renewal fallback reserve
lines.basis: Annual film renewal before project end: months12/24 for ST01,18/30 for ST02/03. With no exact optical-cap price, reserve a full SEN0680 per event, not an invented cap price. This is a conservative funding reserve, not a replacement instruction.

lines.label: pH stock replenishment reserve
lines.basis: Annual planning replenishment allowance, not manufacturer replacement deadline; preserves one initial shared spare. Condition may require more or less.

lines.label: One shared AGM replacement allowance
lines.basis: Condition-based pool; not automatic replacement of every battery at month36.

lines.label: One shared Q190 repair-parts allowance
lines.basis: Condition-based parts pool; labour/travel are in the incident row.

lines.label: One shared SEN0710 damage allowance
lines.basis: Condition-based reserve, not a claim the probe fails during the project.

lines.label: End-of-project collection and disposal allowance
lines.basis: Per station covering battery/electronics/probe/chemical handling; final-round crew travel already counted. No free programme eligibility is assumed.

allocationRule: CAPEX and lifecycle reserves divided equally; OPEX allocated by36/30/30 station-months. Bookkeeping allocation only, not per-site contractor pricing.
scopeExclusions: land acquisition, civil river works, confined-space/diving/boat access
permanent24/7staffed contractual SLA or large enterprise hosting
a motorised wiper or flood-proof civil structure; planning uses monthly manual cleaning
raw-data retention beyond the stated assumed cloud envelope
disclosures: All allowance values are analyst choices, not vendor averages or quotations.
A complete modelled scope is not a complete verified installation. Low/high scenarios are not probability or confidence bounds.
No student or named teammate is assigned as an operator, payer or field signatory.
No free labour, free cloud capacity, free replacement caps or confirmed grants are assumed.
